criteria.description: Correctly characterizes forward chaining as data-driven with an example.
Correctly characterizes backward chaining as goal-driven with an example.

solutions.fullSolution: Forward chaining starts from known facts and fires whatever rules apply regardless of relevance, like automatic/unconscious processing. Backward chaining starts from a specific query and only explores what's needed to answer it, like deliberate problem-solving. Forward is natural for deriving all consequences of new information; backward is natural for one specific question, avoiding wasted work on irrelevant facts.
